notes.title: Spring Sales & Update 1.1 are now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
[h3][b]Dead Alone is now available on sale at -25% as part of the Spring Sale event! Make sure to grab it before March 21st! [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472482/aadba89acae8c4ae2cd6acbf9044d9ebd196259e.png[/img]



Today I also got a small new update for the game, which include many bugfixes and changes reported by some players! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44472482/af73f64aedaf192ba405ec7e859658e04938326f.png[/img][list]
[*] Added the ability to remove traps that did not yet explode
[*] Fixed a major issue that could cause the player to be soft-lock during the introduction if he did not have anymore ressources to build a trap
[*] Reworked projectiles physics to fix projectiles glitching through walls and floors
[*] Fixed an issue in the construction site area that could cause zombies to spawn in areas that could not be reached by the player
[*] Fixed an issue that could create a corrupted save file when opening a bunker
[*] Fixed various issues with save files that could load incorrect datas
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause zombies to spawn directly after respawning, which is not intended
[*] Fixed and improved AI path finding in several areas of the map
[*] Improved performances at night in foliage-dense areas
[*] Fixed an area that could cause the player to fall under the map
[*] Improved collisions on several objects across the map to allow for better navigation in the map and avoid collisions that could stuck the player
[*] Various UI-related bugfixes
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause some menus to not open at low framerates
[*] Fixed various visual glitches on zombies models
[*] Slightly increased the detection radius for the buildable traps
[*] Various other small changes and bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Dead Alone is now officially available !
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

[b]Dead Alone is now officially available in its 1.0 version! [/b]
After more than 3 years of work, i'm really excited to deliver the final version to the game and release it!

[b]The Demo Version of the game as received an update as well.[/b] This update aims to give a better representation of the gameplay experience that the game will offer. The demo is now a bit longer and has been updated with the latest build of the game to include all the improvements and fixes made recently. 


With this 1.0 release, there have been a lot of changes and improvements made to the game since the last beta version. Let’s check the most important ones in the patch notes below: 

[list]
[*] Optimisation
[list]
    [*] Large cpu performance improvements which should result in better frametime stability and better framerates overall
    [*] Fixed various audio/graphical issues and improved gpu performances on several areas of the map
[/list]
[*] World
[list]
    [*] Added many world interactions accross the map in the survival gamemode. Those interactions include various puzzles to access supply chests and hidden gear
    [*] Zombies can now spawn in free roam to add more challenge to the overall exploration experience and make the world feel less empty
    [*] Global polish on the whole map to improve collisions, navigation and gameplay
    [*] Fixed an issues with tree leaves that could block or deflect bullets in some conditions
    [*] Fixed various collisions issues with some buildings
[/list]
[*] AI
[list]
    [*] Improved overall AI behavior and animations to make it move in a smoother way
    [*] Improved AI navigation in several areas of the map, this should reduce instances of AIs getting stuck or being unable to reach the player
    [*] Tweaked AI attack behavior to be more consistent with the animations
    [*] Improved hit detection on zombies
[/list]
[*] Weapons
[list]
    [*] Fixed a major issue that could cause the crossbow to wrongly deal damages to the player character
    [*] Reworked the way reloading work to end the reload actually at the end of the timer and not a few seconds after. This will make reloading a lot faster and less penalizing than it was
    [*] Pressing the sprint input while reloading will no longer cancel the reload
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused the weapon swap animation to be slower than intended if reloading
    [*] Fixed an issue that allowed to see and equip weapons that are not unlocked
    [*] Weapons are now automatically reloaded on death
    [*] Improved and reworked various gunshot sounds
    [*] Fixed an issue that could cause newly equipped weapons to have the wrong appearance
    [*] Bullets will no longer ricochet on zombies
[/list]
[*] UI
[list]
    [*] Added an option in the new game menu to skip the tutorial introduction
    [*] Reworked inventory layout to only display the most relevant informations
    [*] Updated brightness setting to affect the entire game, menus included
    [*] The blood overlay is now less visible when the player’s health is above 50HPs
    [*] Fixed an issue with the crosshair wrongly displaying an ennemy indicator in some conditions
    [*] Reworked and updated some tutorials
    [*] Fixed an issue that could cause the tutorials to block the player’s progression
    [*] Various other UI changes and improvements
[/list]
[*] Balancing
[list]
    [*] Rebalanced most crafting costs
    [*] Improved the ground loot system to avoid confusions on which items have been looted or not
    [*] Global rebalancing of the ground loot
    [*] Many balance changes to weapons and zombies
    [*] Increased max capacity for projectiles and heal items
[/list]
[*] Miscellaneous
[list]
    [*] Fixed an issue that could break the day/night cycle by sleeping multiple times
    [*] Improved projectiles physics to reduce instances of projectiles going through the ground
    [*] Remove walk stance as it could be confusing if triggered by accident
    [*] Fixed various issues with player’s death
    [*] Added visual and audio damage feedbacks to all kind of damages
    [*] Added multiple auto saves at some important moments
    [*] Sleeping will now properly regenerate your stamina
    [*] Improved global audio mix and reworked zombies audio
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused only some types of zombies to spawn in the introduction area
    [*] Various fixes and improvements to the endless gamemode
[/list]
[/list]
And many more unlisted small changes and bugfixes!

notes.title: New Dead Alone playtest available !
notes.content:
Hey everyone ! 

A new update for Dead Alone is available right now with a lot of changes, fixes and even some new features !

With this update, a new playtest will be available for 2 weeks.  I will share more informations about the official release date of the game in the upcoming weeks !

Don’t forget to wishlist the game if you wish to support me! 

Anyway, let’s check the patch notes for this update !

[list]
[*] The biggest addition with this update is the Construction Mode ! With this new feature you will be able to build traps anywhere you want and even repair explosive barrels to use them again.
All these constructions will obviously cost you some ressources but they are a great way to prepare the area before engaging with a new group of ennemies.
[previewyoutube=tEPS44h1Ec0;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] This update also include a rework to the handlings of projectiles. This rework has the goal to make the use of projectiles easier by reducing the amount of interactions needed to throw one.
By default you will now always have one projectile equipped which you can quickly throw at any time with a single button click. You can still change projectile type with the selection wheel by holding G.
[*] With this update I also added a new sleeping buff for the survival gamemode: “Efficient killing”
This buff give you 50% chances of refiling one ammunition when killing an ennemy with a shotgun, sniper or rifle
[/list]


[h3]Other changes and fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a proper death animation for the player
[*] Some inputs have been modified to support the projectiles rework, if you previously changed the keybinds for those inputs, you will need to rebind them in the settings.
[list]
    [*] Shoot / Throw Projectile → Fire
    [*] Aim / Projectile Prediction → Aim
    [*] New Input: Throw Projectile (default: Middle Mouse Button)
    [*] New Input: Toggle Construction Mode (default: T)
[/list]
[*] Made multiple changes to the character mesh to avoid camera clipping when some animations where playing
[*] Pressing the sprint input while aiming with a sniper won’t stop aiming anymore
[*] The nearest workbench is now displayed on the compass
[*] Added various animations to several UIs
[*] Various optimisation and changes to artifical lights
[*] Various tweaks to the difficulty balance including:
[list]
    [*] All damages from explosions and fire are now reduced for lower difficulties
    [*] Various tweaks to the spawning delays of zombies based on the difficulty of the wave
[/list]
[*] Improved projectiles hit detection to remove instances of zombies not taking damages from frag grenades
[*] When zombies are desoriented (by a smoke grenade or explosive for example) they can’t attack the player anymore
[*] Fixed a major issue in the survival gamemode that was causing ground loot to spawn in misplaced locations
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the ADS scope to be misaligned when moving right which made aiming with some weapons very difficult
[*] Fixed various issues that caused the fast travel to be unavailable more often than it should
[*] Fixed many issues with the saving system including:
[list]
    [*] An issue that could cause the game to display a black screen when loading a save
    [*] An issue that caused the player to be unable to equip a weapon when loading a save
    [*] An issue that prevented supply rooms doors to be properly unlocked when loading a save
    [*] An issue that could cause the lighting to be overly bright in some instances
[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Horde Shop to display “common rarity” upgrades
[*] Fixed various issues with compass icons
[*] Fixed an issue that could allow to throw a projectile while healing
[*] Fixed various issues with the endless gamemode (available when completed the horde of survival gamemodes), including an issue causing the timer between waves to not be paused properly when in the pause menu which could lead zombies to not spawn
[*] Fixed various graphical issues
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.41 update available to playtest !
notes.content:
Hey everyone !

I first want to thanks everyone playing the playtest and sending me valuable feedbacks !

I got a small update for Dead Alone today, it includes a complete rework for the workbench UIs and many quality of life changes and fixes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541400/Dead_Alone/]Make sure to add Dead Alone to your Steam wishlist if you want to support me ![/url]

Anyway, let’s check what changes this update brings with the patch notes right below !

[h3]Features:[/h3]
With this update, the Workbench UI has been completely redone to offer a more easy and clean experience when navigating the different menus, I have made a quick video to showcase this brand new UI: 

[previewyoutube=HPfXtTvyU2I;full][/previewyoutube]
Now, let’s talk a bit about the changes that have been done. Overall, all the UI elements have been simplified to reduce the number of actions required to do a specific thing. The simplification also help greatly to display only the most important and relevant informations without useless visual clutter. 
[list]
[*] First of all, the initial menu that showed up when interacting with the workbench has been removed and the 3 sub menus are now accesibles through tabs on top of the screen. When interacting with the workbench, you will now be presented directly with the weapons list menu, no more useless clicks !
[*] The weapons list menu has seen a lot of changes too, the list is now more compact with only the most important stats visible for each unlocked weapon, the 3D model of the weapon is also displayed on the right of the screen.
[*] The details and upgrade UI for weapons has also been completely reworked. You can now see all the stats of the weapon on the left panel as well as the upgrades available on the right, when hovering an upgrade you will see the new stats compared with the current one in a way more intuitive and simple manner. 
You can also see stats such as killed ennemies, headshots, accuracy, etc with the “show weapons stats” button on the bottom.
[*] Once you are done with weapons, you can take a look at the equipement upgrades panel ! Here, all the useless submenus have been removed and merged into one single UI. 
You can directly see the list of all the equipements on the left with only the relevant stats and informations. And on the right all the available upgrades for the hovered equipement. 
Just like for the weapons, hovering each upgrade display the new stat compared to the current one.
[*] And finally, the Crafting UI has also seen some various changes, the list of crafts on the left has been simplified and now only require an hover to display the selected craft instead of doing it with a button. The UI on the left and right have also been reworked to reduce instances of overlapping on some screen resolutions. 
The crafting list for ammunitions has been tweaked to display ammos for the equipped weapons on top of the list in order to make it easier to craft relevant ammunitions
[/list]

All those changes allow for a better and far easier experience when navigating this very important menu.

[h3]Changes and fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each weapon type now has a specific crosshair
[*] Improved animations when swapping weapon while reloading
[*] Improved visual and audio feedback when taking damages
[*] The resolution setting will now display all available resolutions for the screen plugged in instead of a fixed set of resolutions
[*] Improved AI attacking behavior to reduce instances of unregistered hit
[*] Added particle effect when the player is on fire. Molotov and explosive barrels now also properly deal fire damage over time
[*] Various improvement to UIs
[*] Improved AI reaction and feedback to melee attacks
[*] (Horde) Fixed a major issue that caused the shop to close instantly after opening it
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the crafting system to always consider the sleeping buff “Clever Crafting” as active
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the “break timer” to be skipped even if the player did not press the input
[*] Various fixes to the ‘window mode’ settings not being applied correctly
[/list]
